before.title: Beluga whale · extensively resculpted CC0 control surface
before.author: 3D Assets (CC0 source); PhenoVoxel Archive (MIT additions)
before.delivery: Bundled original CC0 GLB retained byte-exact. Active control surface is extensively resampled/resculpted with new appendages, face, oral anatomy and original skin maps.
before.biology: Contributor-reported AI-generated static model. Source dimensions are asset authoring units, not biological measurements; no source skeleton, animation or tissue data. New selected adult exterior is reference-led and unvalidated.
changes: Decoded the quantized source control surface without clamping; retained 81 body ring stations, resampled to 161 rings and 96 circumferential segments; changed proportions, forehead, chin, neck, trunk and peduncle.
Replaced simplified source appendages, facial marks and ridge with rounded pectorals, broad horizontal flukes, low dorsal ridge, inset eyes/lids, single blowhole and integrated split lips.

Added a separate selected 36-tooth oral cavity, gums and tongue; exterior pursing and gular depression follow published stage order. No live scan, anatomical dissection, pressure, prey or swallowing solver.
Original ivory/normal/roughness texture fields; no supplied-image pixels. Finite stroke, glide, head turn, melon-contour and feeding studies; no source or independently validated motion.

viewerRig.author: PhenoVoxel Archive
viewerRig.scope: Zero skeletal joints. Selected exterior deformation; no fitted muscles, pressure, trajectory or independent biological validation.
viewerRig.spatialScale: 3.85 normalized display units from rostrum to fluke notch; not a metric reconstruction of the user photographs.

after.title: Beluga whale · revised adult exterior and face
after.author: 3D Assets (CC0 source); PhenoVoxel Archive (MIT additions)
after.delivery: Bundled original CC0 GLB retained byte-exact. Active control surface is extensively resampled/resculpted with new appendages, face, oral anatomy and original skin maps.
after.biology: Contributor-reported AI-generated static model. Source dimensions are asset authoring units, not biological measurements; no source skeleton, animation or tissue data. New selected adult exterior is reference-led and unvalidated.
changes: Retained the untouched CC0 starting file. Added denser anterior control stations to the resculpted surface, a rounded cap and a fuller, distinct melon/short rostrum/neck profile. Removed the former zero-at-pole axial bump that folded nose rings back through one another.

Rebuilt pectorals as swept solid cambered foils with full roots and thinner trailing edges. Revised the fluke leading/trailing contours. New layered small eyes and tapered skin eyelids replace dot-like eyes and tube lids; lip overlays removed in favour of a continuous shallow skin groove.

New original cream-grey skin, fine normal and variable roughness fields with sparse authored pale marks. Appendages use body-position UV coordinates so facial tones do not appear on flippers. Reduced beluga fill/rim lighting leaves the surface volume visible.

Existing bounded posterior stroke, glide, neck, turning, melon and separate feeding/oral actions retained and checked against the revised geometry. Selected36peg teeth remain an authored anatomy display. No measured individual, living scan, tissue mechanics, pressure/prey/water solver or scientifically validated motion.
Recessed and curved the oral floor, palate and tongue, adding restrained original vertex colour variation and posterior depth tones. The internal display remains simplified and unvalidated.

before.status: Reference-led beluga exterior and finite behavior rebuild; physiology and realism require further independent validation
remaining: Selected adult-white phenotype; sex, stock, body condition and exact metric dimensions are unresolved. Uncalibrated mixed photos cannot establish one individual or photogrammetric scale.

Body/appendage transitions, cervical motion, lip seals and tongue/gular displacements are selected exterior approximations. No fitted joints, muscle mechanics, tissue-volume conservation or complete internal anatomy.
No solved swimming trajectory, thrust, buoyancy, fluid pressure, prey transport, swallowing, breathing or echolocation; social meanings cannot be read from melon shape or a smile-like jawline.
Software compatibility lighting reviewed separately; natural tissue optics and final WebGL optical fidelity are not independently established.

Observed software-view limits: faint fine skin detail, geometric lip rims and shoulder joins, subtle gular displacement and tiny ridge-edge raster marks. The oral field remains simplified; these views do not establish photorealistic living tissue.

before.description: Resculpted adult beluga with rounded overhanging melon, short broad rostrum, soft lips/chin, lateral eyes and a cervical transition into a fuller tapering trunk. Broad rounded pectorals, a low dorsal ridge and wide horizontal notched flukes replace the simplified source appendages. Restrained ivory skin includes sparse folds, fine numerical relief and selected faint scars. Feeding shows lip pursing, anterior aperture opening, gular depression and closure; a separate oral view exposes selected worn peg teeth and the tongue. This is an unvalidated reference-led reconstruction from a disclosed AI-origin CC0 control surface.

after.description: Revised adult beluga exterior with a rounded melon, short projecting rostrum, shallow mouth groove, fuller chin, small recessed layered eyes and tapered skin eyelids. Swept pectorals have thick roots, curved leading edges and thinner trailing edges; revised flukes remain horizontal and notched. Original cream-grey skin has restrained irregular pigmentation, fine relief and sparse pale marks. The original CC0 AI-origin starting file is retained; this authored derivative is not a living scan or a measured animal. Finite swimming, neck, melon and feeding studies remain illustrative and unvalidated.
